reviewContext.userProblem: The pair (comparison) view in 0.4.0 hides the left file list entirely, has no keyboard shortcuts to hide/show panes, and only supports exactly two files; three or more files fall back to the single-document explicit file set view.
requiredOutcomes: `chilla a.png b.png` opens pair view with a.png left, b.png right and the file list folded; the header sidebar toggle, the left-edge strip (.workspace__expand-tab) and Shift+L expand/fold the list, which shows both files with L/R markers.
`chilla a.png b.png c.png` opens pair view with a.png left and b.png right; the list shows all three in CLI order; activating the right pane and choosing c.png shows c.png on the right.
'{' and '}' toggle the left and right pane through the keymap (rebindable, in keyboard help), are no-ops outside pair view and in editable fields; both panes can never be hidden.
Single-file and directory launches behave exactly as before.
Rust and TypeScript unit/DOM tests cover CLI classification for 2 and 3+ files, initial folded list, active-pane selection and loading, list markers and the new shortcuts.
cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test, bun run typecheck, mise run test (bun test, vitest DOM) and biome pass; the debug app is launched with three image files per chilla-post-edit-launch.
nonGoals: No change to macOS Finder / Apple Event open-files or the frontend picker path (startupContextForPickedTarget); they still build explicit_file_set contexts.
No editing, TOC or markdown-mode switching in pair view; no pane resize, synchronized scroll/zoom, per-pane file watching, or persistence of pane assignment/active pane/visibility.
No directory browsing from the pair file list.
No edits to unrelated files; .riela/ untracked directories are left alone.
constraints: Two or more distinct regular-file CLI arguments open pair view: first unique file left, second right, all unique files in argument order in the folded list; fewer than two unique files is a single-file open; directory arguments keep current behavior.

StartupTarget::FileSet and BrowserRoot::ExplicitFileSet startup variants are removed; FilePair carries rest and source_order_paths; Rust and TypeScript sides of the file_pair payload and list_explicit_file_set source_order argument change together.
Keep per-pane eye icons, restore strip, hidden-pane zoom guard, '+'/'-' visible-pane zoom and 'r' reload of shown files.
Reuse existing viewers and FileBrowserPane explicit-list rendering; no duplicated viewers; no emojis.
Follow AGENTS.md, rust-coding-standards and ts-coding-standards; CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true for cargo commands.

Each worker edits only its plan's writePaths, records pre/post sha256 for edited existing files, and appends to its own plan progress log; evidence goes under tmp/pair-multi-20261116-01/<planId>/<attempt>/ (untracked, data only).
src/app/App.css is shared: pair-multi-file-browser adds one localized .file-browser__pair-marker block in wave 1; pair-multi-workspace may add a minimal pair-mode grid rule in wave 2 only if needed.
Runtime launch must be a bounded foreground run logging to /tmp/chilla-pair-multi-launch.log; no nohup or background launch.
Commit messages must not contain AI attribution or Co-Authored-By lines.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Classification becomes unique >= 2 -> StartupTarget::FilePair { left, right, rest }; FileSet startup variant removed.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Every multi-file CLI launch now opens pair view; a single variant keeps exhaustive matches on both sides honest (design-pair-view.md Startup Classification).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: BrowserRoot::FilePair gains source_order_paths (list[0] == left, list[1] == right, length >= 2) validated by the TS normalizer.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The frontend needs the full ordered list to populate the folded file list; validation rejects inconsistent payloads (Startup Payload Contract).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: list_explicit_file_set gains an optional source_order flag that skips sorting; FileBrowserPane gains sourceOrder and a pair marker callback.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The pair list must show files in CLI order and reuse existing explicit-list rendering with L / R / LR badges (Source-Order Listing Contract, List Markers).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Pair state (left/right paths, active pane, visibility) is owned by WorkspaceShell; PairView becomes controlled and is no longer keyed.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: List choices from FileBrowserPane must route into the active pane and re-show a hidden pane without remounting the viewers (State Ownership).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: List choices route through WorkspaceShell handleConfirmEntry (click and Enter); onSelectEntry cursor moves load nothing.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: FileBrowserPane row click and confirmEntry both call onConfirmEntry, so one branch covers both inputs as the design requires.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: New keymap actions pair.left.toggle / pair.right.toggle with default bindings '{' / '}' and static help entries.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Registered through the existing keymap system, so they are rebindable and listed in keyboard help (Pane Toggle Shortcuts).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Two waves: six independent wave-1 plans with disjoint writePaths, then pair-multi-workspace integrates and runs the full gates.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Maximizes parallelism; WorkspaceShell integration depends on all pinned wave-1 contracts.

intentionalTradeoffs: Launches with three or more files (including `a b a`) now open pair view instead of the explicit file set single-document view; this intentionally replaces prior behavior.
Users with a custom workspace keymap that replaces defaults do not get '{' / '}' until they add them.

Until wave 2 lands, the WorkspaceShell.vitest file_pair fixture fails the new normalizer validation and WorkspaceShell.tsx has type errors from new PairView props; wave-1 plans scope typecheck to owned paths and wave 2 runs the full gates.
The GUI launch check may be recorded as partial with /tmp/chilla-pair-multi-launch.log if no GUI interaction is possible.
supportedEdgeCases: `a b` -> FilePair(a, b, rest []); `a b c` -> FilePair(a, b, rest [c]); `a b a` -> FilePair(a, b, rest []).
`a a`, `a ./a` -> File(a); directory or mixed directory+file arguments keep the existing behavior and errors.
The same file shown in both panes gets an LR marker.
Choosing a file while the active pane is hidden loads it and shows that pane again.
Pressing the toggle key for the only visible pane is a no-op; '{' / '}' outside pair view or while typing do nothing.
Sort key bindings are inert in source-order list mode; the list keeps CLI order.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: macOS Apple Event open-files or picker delivery of two or more files.
Synchronized zoom/scroll and live file watching per pane.
Persisting pane assignment, active pane or visibility across launches.
Directory browsing from the pair file list.
